scope: Completed primary L/S endpoints only. Ongoing M, conditional backup and noise evaluations excluded. Not the final stage conclusion.

metric_definitions.stable_horizon_risk: 0.8 mean + 0.2 mean of the largest ceil(0.1n) event time-mean original normalized point errors; not RMSE
metric_definitions.records: original normalized trajectory RMSE, with physical delta_rmse_rad and omega_rmse_rad_s when provided
metric_definitions.normalized_p: original frozen-scale normalized p RMSE, dimensionless
metric_definitions.objective_point_error: original normalized squared point error, not RMSE
metric_definitions.classification_actual15s: original available-interval classification, at most 15s; intervals differ from fixed 8s predictions
metric_definitions.classification_denominators: misses use numerically admissible unstable rows; false alarms use numerically admissible stable rows, separately by label
metric_definitions.timing: panel qualified inference seconds retain the original evaluation scope, not a claim of pure 8s deployment time
